newsitem.title: BELGIUM: WALLOON REGION SELLING CELEGEC ACEC STAKE -SOURCES.
newsitem.headline: WALLOON REGION SELLING CELEGEC ACEC STAKE -SOURCES.

text.p: The Walloon region is cashing in its 49 percent stake in Celegec Acec, the electro- mechanical subsidiary of GEC Alsthom, sources close to the Walloon government said on Thursday.

A candidate for the stake was not yet known, but it was possible that in view of its strategy of full control of units the parent company might snap up the stake, raising its holding in the unit to 100 percent, they said.
GEC-Alsthom is a joint venture between France's Alcatel Alsthom and Britain's GEC plc. Other units in Wallonia are Acec-Transport and GEC Alsthom Acec Energie.
